_comment: What a release of the platform holds: the modules, and every file a
module reads from outside its own directory, at the path it has in the
repository. The fabricator packs exactly these and publishes them as one
versioned package, which is what a site runs.
Not a list to keep by hand. scripts/details/platform reads what the
modules reach for off their own code, and its tests fail when this file
names more or less than that.
